[raw.pixls.us](https://raw.pixls.us/getfile.php/1327/nice/Canon%20-%20Canon%20PowerShot%20A410%20-%2010bit%2010bit%20CHDK%20ver.%201.5.0%20%284%3A3%29.DNG).

- Original size: 4.02 MB; 3.34 MP

`L1002126.DNG` is the user-supplied 36.6 MP Leica integration fixture used to catch
Safari memory, file-access, preview, and export regressions. SHA-256:
`af542c878c0abef19b1df39e5f9331093d3005144da6223e9bea35b38b44a13d`.
